verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, and they share the same flaws. In both, 'Sunset Sessions' sits almost on the left edge, and the middle column is crammed: the date, the indented '6 pm' line, the pills, the oversized RSVP button and unreadably small legal text are stacked tightly with uneven left edges. The phone also overlaps the placeholder graphic on the right. A wins narrowly because its three pills are compact and evenly spaced. In B the pills are flatter and spread unevenly, the 'Tastings' pill drifts towards the phone, and its pill labels look squeezed.
